package validation

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

const maximumResponseBytes int64 = 4 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) InspectContract(ctx context.Context, codeStructure json.RawMessage) (domain.ContractInspection, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"code_structure": codeStructure, "mode": "final"})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ContractInspection{}, err
	}
	var result domain.ContractInspection
	if err := client.post(ctx, "/api/v1/contracts/inspect", payload, &result); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if result.Schema != "validation-contract-inspection.v1" {
		return result, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (client Client) VerifyContract(ctx context.Context, request domain.VerificationRequestV1) (domain.VerificationReceiptV1, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.VerificationReceiptV1{}, err
	}
	var result domain.VerificationReceiptV1
	if err := client.post(ctx, "/api/v1/contracts/verify", payload, &result); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (client Client) post(ctx context.Context, path string, payload []byte, result any) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+path, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return fmt.Errorf("validation authoring endpoint returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 90 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.ValidationAuthoringClient = Client{}
